newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates soar on treasury bill payment.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates soar on treasury bill payment.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates rose sharply at mid-session on Wednesday, with market liquidity squeezed by the payment of T$15 billion in treasury bills, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate was at 6.812 percent against Tuesday's 6.396 close -- well above the central bank's target zone of 5.0-5.5 percent -- with 30-day commercial paper soaring to 6.75-7.00 percent against 5.85-6.25.
Dealers said market operations were handcuffed further by the central bank's planned issue of T$3 billion negotiable certificates of deposit later on Wednesday.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 5.8410-8500 percent against 5.8475.
